source.note: ids only: words, members and NYT group names are re-derived from this file at plan / judge time (wsbench.nyt); none is committed

subject_model: nvidia/NVIDIA-Nemotron-Labs-Dory1.0-4B-BF16, chat template, enable_thinking=False, no system prompt (re-derived on the subject, nyt-self-2026-11-03)
answer_format: members-only (wsbench.nyt.PROMPT_MEMBERS); NVIDIA Dory1.0-4B (2 loops)'s labels from the follow-up naming turn (the pilot's conn_common.NAME_FOLLOWUP), greedy; re-derived on the subject (wsbench.adapt.nyt_connections)

stability.rule: a slot is stable iff the subject's group is in >= 12/16 samples

options: per slot: NVIDIA Dory1.0-4B (2 loops)'s label (role qwen: the subject's own label) + the label of the NYT group sharing the most words (gold) + <= 2 red-herring labels sharing >= 2 words (alt; Opus-written herrings, NYT groups excluded) + 1 other-puzzle NVIDIA Dory1.0-4B (2 loops) label (foil); distractors naming the same connection as NVIDIA Dory1.0-4B (2 loops)'s (near-synonyms included) dropped by an Opus check (the pilot's summ_cat2.EQUIV). Bank v1 label rule: a label that folds equal to ANY NYT group name in the mirror is a reference; an alt equal to the gold is dropped. The judge shuffles by mc.seeded_shuffle('<id>-<slot>') and adds mc.CANNOT last
read_positions: the last 12 tokens of the rendered prompt (readplan rule last_n n=12), before Qwen writes anything
excluded: puzzles whose NVIDIA Dory1.0-4B (2 loops) answer is not a valid partition of the 16 words with all four groups labelled by the follow-up turn
puzzles with fewer than 2 valid red-herring solutions
the registered bank's exclusions (its candidate set is the registered bank's puzzles)
